BL-0.1.4-005-S1.title: Define Local Disk Resilience Schema and Contract
BL-0.1.4-005-S1.description: Define a standardized contract for resilient file operations including retry policy, fallback behavior, error classification, and operation metadata (operation type, file path, attempt count, outcome).
BL-0.1.4-005-S1.evidence: ASSUMPTION: No existing resilience contract; GAP requires standardized interface for safe file operations

BL-0.1.4-005-S2.title: Implement Retry and Fallback Logic for File Operations
BL-0.1.4-005-S2.description: Implement core logic to handle transient file system failures using configurable retries with exponential backoff and safe fallback behaviors (e.g., temp file, alternate path, or no-op with error capture).
BL-0.1.4-005-S2.evidence: ASSUMPTION: File operations currently lack retry/fallback handling; GAP requires resilience logic

BL-0.1.4-005-S3.title: Integrate Resilience Wrapper into Existing File Operations
BL-0.1.4-005-S3.description: Wrap existing local disk interactions (e.g., logging, manifest generation, temp artifacts) with the resilience layer to ensure all file operations use the standardized retry and fallback mechanism.

BL-0.1.4-005-S4.title: Add Error Classification, Observability, and Internal API for File Failures
BL-0.1.4-005-S4.description: Implement structured error classification (transient vs permanent), logging, and an internal API/interface to expose file operation outcomes, retry attempts, fallback activation, and final status for debugging and system integration.

BL-0.1.4-005-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Local Disk Resilience
BL-0.1.4-005-S5.description: Create tests covering retry behavior, fallback execution, error classification, and integration with existing file operations, including simulated disk failures and edge cases.
